hero.title: How a bank gets built by AI — the process, disclosed as-is
hero.body: The engineering-process window of Amazing Bank. This site is a pure renderer: it produces no content of its own, but publishes the plans, decisions, iterations, evidence, tests and metrics that the ASDM pipeline generates — straight from the process-assets repository.
hero.phaseNote: Current stage: Sprint v0.0.1 · Part 04 · Phase 3 · Site layer (task 3.1 routing skeleton in place)

directory.title: Eight sections
directory.hint: From methodology to reproduction — every section is a different lens on the same process assets.
